description: Flat context parameters seeded into the project knowledge state before a review. Values are strings so they round-trip through the ledger unchanged. Replace these with your own organization's parameters.

parameters.billing_model: flat fee per deployed workflow; no hourly billing
parameters.governance_pillar_1: data governance - every input has a stated source and retention period
parameters.governance_pillar_2: reliable multi-step reasoning - every conclusion is traceable to an input
parameters.governance_pillar_3: security boundaries - no credential enters an agent-visible context
parameters.governance_pillar_4: human accountability - a named owner signs off before production
parameters.review_gate: no change reaches production without an evidenced approval
parameters.escalation_path: blocking finding -> named owner -> executive sponsor
parameters.naming_dictionary: agent, council, reviewer, finding, verdict, ledger
